decision: Do not invoke the under-specified one-factor bisection contingency in this definitive execution.
reason: The contingency lacks paired control arms, draw IDs, output names, an aggregate command, and factor-level acceptance rules. Its stated cost also omits new paired controls.
definitive_effect: Any candidate that regresses under the frozen E04 grid is rejected. A bisection, if later desired, is a separately predeclared and repriced experiment.
